code: sir_ode <- odin({   deriv(S) <- -beta * S * I / N   deriv(I) <- beta * S * I / N - gamma * I   deriv(R) <- gamma * I   initial(S) <- N - I0   initial(I) <- I0   initial(R) <- 0   N <- parameter(1000)   I0 <- parameter(10)   beta <- parameter(0.4)   gamma <- parameter(0.1) }, quiet = TRUE) pars <- data.frame(beta = seq(0.15, 0.5, by = 0.05)) res <- run_parameter_sets(sir_ode, pars, times = 0:100,                           fixed = list(gamma = 0.1)) res #>  #> ── <monty_samples: 1 parameter x 8 samples x 1 chain> ────────────────────────── #> ℹ Parameters: 'beta' #> ℹ Conversion to other types is possible: #> → ! posterior::as_draws_array() [package installed, but not loaded] #> → ! posterior::as_draws_df() [package installed, but not loaded] #> → ✖ coda::as.mcmc.list() [package missing] #> ℹ These samples have associated observations #> ℹ See `?monty_sample()` and `vignette("samples")` for more information beta <- dplyr::select(tidy_pars(res), sample, beta = value) traj <- dplyr::left_join(tidy_trajectories(res), beta, by = "sample") traj #> # A tibble: 2,424 × 7 #>    chain iteration sample  time variable  value  beta #>    <int>     <int>  <int> <int> <fct>     <dbl> <dbl> #>  1     1         1      1     0 S        990     0.15 #>  2     1         1      1     0 I         10     0.15 #>  3     1         1      1     0 R          0     0.15 #>  4     1         1      1     1 S        988.    0.15 #>  5     1         1      1     1 I         10.5   0.15 #>  6     1         1      1     1 R          1.02  0.15 #>  7     1         1      1     2 S        987.    0.15 #>  8     1         1      1     2 I         11.0   0.15 #>  9     1         1      1     2 R          2.10  0.15 #> 10     1         1      1     3 S        985.    0.15 #> # ℹ 2,414 more rows  ggplot(traj, aes(time, value, colour = beta, group = beta)) +   geom_line() +   facet_wrap(vars(variable)) +   scale_colour_met_c("Hokusai2")

code: data <- data.frame(   time = 1:20,   cases = c(4, 8, 5, 12, 13, 19, 29, 34, 39, 42, 51, 44, 49, 38, 41, 33, 27,             21, 22, 13)) filter <- dust_filter_create(sir, time_start = 0, data = data,                              n_particles = 100, dt = 0.25) packer <- monty_packer(c("beta", "gamma"), fixed = list(N = 1000, I0 = 10)) likelihood <- dust_likelihood_monty(filter, packer, save_trajectories = TRUE,                                     save_state = TRUE) prior <- monty_dsl({   beta ~ Exponential(mean = 0.5)   gamma ~ Exponential(mean = 0.2) }) vcv <- matrix(c(0.051, 0.040, 0.040, 0.035), 2, 2) sampler <- monty_sampler_random_walk(vcv) samples <- monty_sample(likelihood + prior, sampler, 3000,                         initial = c(0.7, 0.45), n_chains = 3) #> ⡀⠀ Sampling [▁▁▁] ■                                |   0% ETA: 49s #> ⠄⠀ Sampling [▂▁▁] ■■                               |   5% ETA:  9s #> ⢂⠀ Sampling [█▂▁] ■■■■■■■■■■■■                     |  38% ETA:  6s #> ⡂⠀ Sampling [██▂] ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■          |  72% ETA:  3s #> ✔ Sampled 9000 steps across 3 chains in 8.9s #>  samples <- monty_samples_thin(samples, burnin = 1000, thinning_factor = 5)  fit <- tidy_trajectories(samples, filter, vars = "incidence") cols <- met.brewer("Demuth", 9) cols_scenario <- c("fit" = cols[8], "baseline" = cols[7],                    "projection" =  cols[7],                   "30% lower transmission" = cols[5])

title: Tidy output from odin2, dust2 and monty
text: stochastic SIR model also tracks daily incidence, can compared case data: Run 30 particles tidy result. tidy_simulation() needs system times well output, array record either:  summarise_trajectories() collapses particles (draws chains, present) ribbon plot:
code: sir <- odin({   update(S) <- S - n_SI   update(I) <- I + n_SI - n_IR   update(R) <- R + n_IR   update(incidence) <- incidence + n_SI   p_SI <- 1 - exp(-beta * I / N * dt)   p_IR <- 1 - exp(-gamma * dt)   n_SI <- Binomial(S, p_SI)   n_IR <- Binomial(I, p_IR)   initial(S) <- N - I0   initial(I) <- I0   initial(R) <- 0   initial(incidence, zero_every = 1) <- 0   N <- parameter(1000)   I0 <- parameter(10)   beta <- parameter(0.4)   gamma <- parameter(0.1)   cases <- data()   cases ~ Poisson(incidence) }, quiet = TRUE) sys <- dust_system_create(sir, list(), n_particles = 30, dt = 0.25) dust_system_set_state_initial(sys) t <- 0:60 y <- dust_system_simulate(sys, t) dim(y) #> [1]  4 30 61  sim <- tidy_simulation(y, sys, t) sim #> # A tibble: 7,320 × 4 #>    particle  time variable  value #>       <int> <int> <fct>     <dbl> #>  1        1     0 S           990 #>  2        1     0 I            10 #>  3        1     0 R             0 #>  4        1     0 incidence     0 #>  5        2     0 S           990 #>  6        2     0 I            10 #>  7        2     0 R             0 #>  8        2     0 incidence     0 #>  9        3     0 S           990 #> 10        3     0 I            10 #> # ℹ 7,310 more rows nms_variable <- unique(sim$variable) cols_variable <- met.brewer("Demuth", length(nms_variable)) names(cols_variable) <- nms_variable  ggplot(sim, aes(time, value, group = particle)) +   geom_line(aes(colour = variable), alpha = 0.3) +   scale_colour_manual(values = cols_variable) +   facet_wrap(vars(variable), scales = "free_y") ggplot(summarise_trajectories(sim), aes(time)) +   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = variable), alpha = 0.3) +   geom_line(aes(y = median, colour = variable)) +   scale_fill_manual(values = cols_variable, aesthetics = c("fill", "colour")) +   facet_wrap(vars(variable), scales = "free_y")

code: sir_age <- odin({   update(S[]) <- S[i] - n_SI[i]   update(I[]) <- I[i] + n_SI[i] - n_IR[i]   update(R[]) <- R[i] + n_IR[i]   p_SI <- 1 - exp(-beta * sum(I) / sum(N) * dt)   p_IR <- 1 - exp(-gamma * dt)   n_SI[] <- Binomial(S[i], p_SI)   n_IR[] <- Binomial(I[i], p_IR)   initial(S[]) <- N[i] - 5   initial(I[]) <- 5   initial(R[]) <- 0   N <- parameter()   beta <- parameter(0.4)   gamma <- parameter(0.1)   n_age <- parameter(2)   dim(S, I, R, n_SI, n_IR, N) <- n_age }, quiet = TRUE)  sys <- dust_system_create(sir_age, list(N = c(300, 700)), n_particles = 10) dust_system_set_state_initial(sys) y <- dust_system_simulate(sys, t)  sim_age <- tidy_simulation(y, sys, t, dims = "age",                            labels = list(age = c("children", "adults"))) sim_age #> # A tibble: 3,660 × 5 #>    particle  time variable age      value #>       <int> <int> <fct>    <fct>    <dbl> #>  1        1     0 S        children   295 #>  2        1     0 S        adults     695 #>  3        1     0 I        children     5 #>  4        1     0 I        adults       5 #>  5        1     0 R        children     0 #>  6        1     0 R        adults       0 #>  7        2     0 S        children   295 #>  8        2     0 S        adults     695 #>  9        2     0 I        children     5 #> 10        2     0 I        adults       5 #> # ℹ 3,650 more rows  ggplot(sim_age, aes(time, value, colour = age,                     group = interaction(age, particle))) +   geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +   facet_wrap(vars(variable)) +   scale_colour_met_d("Kandinsky")
